name: codemouse
description: CodeMouse automatically reviews every pull request in your GitHub repositories using AI models running on your own API keys. This plugin gives ChatGPT read-only access to your CodeMouse account: list the accounts you belong to, see which GitHub organizations and repositories are connected, browse recent pull-request reviews, and pull full detail on any single review — status, findings posted, per-model runs, duration, and cost. Ask things like "what did CodeMouse flag on my last PR?" or "how much did reviews cost this week?". All tools are read-only and scoped to the organizations you are a member of; the plugin cannot approve, merge, comment on, or change anything. Sign-in uses OAuth. A CodeMouse account is required.

defaultPrompt: What did CodeMouse flag on my latest pull request?
How much did my code reviews cost this week?
Which of my repositories does CodeMouse review?

positive.description: List the CodeMouse accounts the signed-in user belongs to.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the account "CodeMouse Demo" with its id and the user's role; no other accounts.

positive.description: Show which GitHub repositories CodeMouse reviews for the account.
positive.prompt: Which repositories does CodeMouse review for me?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the demo repository connected to the CodeMouse Demo account with its GitHub organization name.

positive.description: Browse recent pull-request reviews, newest first.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the four demo reviews with PR number, title, status (completed/merged) and date, newest first.

positive.description: Get full detail of one review.
positive.prompt: Show me the full detail of my latest CodeMouse review.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the latest review's status, findings posted, per-model runs, duration and cost, and summarises them in plain language.

positive.description: Aggregate cost across recent reviews from review detail.
positive.prompt: How much did my code reviews cost this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Reads cost from the reviews' detail and reports a total in USD (the demo reviews have small non-zero costs), stating the period covered.

negative.description: Write action that the plugin does not support (no write tools exist).
negative.prompt: Approve and merge my latest pull request.

negative.description: Destructive action that the plugin does not support.
negative.prompt: Delete the CodeMouse review for my latest pull request.

negative.description: Data outside the connected account; tools are scoped to the user's own organizations.
negative.prompt: Show me the CodeMouse reviews for the squidcode/codemouse repository (an organization I am not a member of).

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial directory release: read-only access to CodeMouse accounts, repositories and pull-request reviews. Adds an email/password review sign-in for the reviewer test account alongside GitHub OAuth.
